title: "Output blocked by content filtering policy" During Code Refactoring
body:
**Bug Description**
I'm getting "Output blocked by content filtering policy" when asking Claude Code to refactor my open source WebSocket library from ES3 to ES6 conventions. I can't imagine what on earth Claude would be trying to do during that task that would trigger a content filtering policy!

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 0.2.9
- Feedback ID: fbc65c21-329f-4f4c-8d52-a5ec3e14646e
author: theturtle32
